# ClearCrest Water & Air

> Whole-home water softening, PFAS drinking water filtration, and whole-house
> air purification for Utah homeowners. Free 20-minute in-home water and air
> test with a written ClearCrest Home Report.
> Email: schedule@clearcresthome.com

## Services
- Water: non-electric twin-tank softening for Utah's 15 to 30+ gpg hard water,
  reverse osmosis, certified PFAS reduction media, UV disinfection
- Air: MERV 13-16 media air cleaners in the existing return duct, in-duct UV
  purification for inversion and wildfire smoke seasons
- CrestCare maintenance memberships from $29/month (salt delivery, filter and
  media changes, UV lamp replacement); water systems from $5,000, financing available
